newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: City Dev sees full 1996 to be better.
newsitem.headline: City Dev sees full 1996 to be better.

text.p: Property company City Developments Ltd (City Dev) said on Friday the company is confident its results for full 1996 would surpass those of 1996.

Commenting on the company's first half results showing the net profit rising 33.7 percent to Singapore $209.72 million, City Dev said higher rental revenues from investment properties will continue to be boosted by Republic Plaza for the second half of the year.

It said the group's London, regional U.K. and New York hotels should benefit from the buoyancy of their respective hotel markets, and the refurbished Gloucester, Bailey's Hotel and The Chelsea in London and the Plaza in New York will underpin this growth.
